title: A vestal’s lamp
html_source:
Vestal: Of the Roman goddess Vesta

Vesta was the goddess of the hearth, of huge significance to the Romans. The Roman shrine to Vesta was guarded by Vestal virgins.

Vesta, herself was a virgin all her life.

Eglinton was celibate.

Also used by ‘the professor’ in Aeolus under Life on the Raw: Vestal virgins.
